name: lw_6005
statement: (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((1 / (a + (i : ℕ) * b))))^2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((1 / (a + (i : ℕ) * b))^2)) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1^2))
closed: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((1 / (a + (i : ℕ) * b))))^2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((1 / (a + (i : ℕ) * b))^2)) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1^2))
type: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, 1 / (a + ↑i * b)) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 / (a + ↑i * b)) ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, 1 ^ 2
